findings.description: Pedro Pablo Chaves married Juana Flores on 30 August 1859 at Asuncion de Maria Santisima, Avellaneda, Buenos Aires, Argentina; she was the daughter of Sebastian Flores and Isabel Rivero.

details.marriage: 30 August 1859, Asuncion de Maria Santisima, Avellaneda, Buenos Aires, Argentina (a second index of the same couple dates it 14 September 1859 at Buenos Aires City)

supporting_sources: Argentina, Buenos Aires, registros parroquiales, 1635-2017 — entry for Pedro Chaves and Juana Flores, 30 Aug 1859, Asuncion de Maria Santisima, Avellaneda, naming his parents Isidro Chaves and Andrea Guerra and hers Sebastian Flores and Isabel Rivero (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QP84-TH55)

Argentina, Buenos Aires, registros parroquiales, 1635-2017 — second index of the same couple and the same four parents, dated 14 Sep 1859 at Buenos Aires City (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QJRM-GV8V)
